title: Introduction to Working with Data
description: A practical, data-first introduction to working with real data in R, set in a Kenyan context. Each chapter opens with a real case study and an interactive STACK question, then works through the skills that come before any trustworthy result: understanding how data is structured, exploring and cleaning it, reshaping it, handling factors and missing values, and measuring and accounting for variability. No prior R experience is needed, and no mathematics beyond arithmetic.
subject: general
